description: Capability for the project windows. `allow-destroy` is required: the app listens for tauri://close-requested (to leave collaboration presence before quitting), which makes the core prevent the native close and hand the window's fate to the frontend — without the permission the red traffic light would do nothing. `project-*` covers the windows `open_project_window` creates; they run the same app as `main` and a capability listing only `main` would leave them unable to call anything.
